cause: The Windows Z105C Build All run passed dependency setup, build-profile validation, strict rustfmt and cargo check --workspace --all-targets. Strict Clippy then exposed five native-editor lint failures: two obsolete dead methods, two manually implemented enum defaults that are derivable, and one nested SceneRectangles inspector condition that is collapsible.

repairs.obsoleteWorldCanvasClick: Remove handle_world_canvas_click; continuous world canvas press/drag authoring is routed through the newer gesture path and the old single-click helper has no callers.
repairs.obsoleteIslandChunkCycle: Remove cycle_selected_island_scene_cell; storage-partition cycling is obsolete in the continuous Alderreach authoring model and the helper has no callers.
repairs.worldEditToolDefault: Derive Default on WorldEditTool and mark Select with #[default].
repairs.worldLayerModeDefault: Derive Default on WorldLayerMode and mark Terrain with #[default].
repairs.sceneRectangleInspectorInput: Collapse the nested SceneRectangles/right-panel inspector condition without changing input routing order.
